summary:
[TO BOB —| 

 


Sorry to be so late in thanking you for the neat-o pictures of Sue (I’ve been in bed for three weeks almost with the fucking flu). In one of the pictures Sue looks very sad. I hope this does not reveal the real Sue. Anyhow, I appreciate them very much, but I have not put them up on the walls of the apartment yet for reasons that remain obscure. They certainly would make good conversation pieces; people would exclaim and then ask, “Who is she?” and I would casually answer, “Oh, a friend.” Then I could feel like Mr. Important again; the flu has made me feel like a little boy home sick from school, confined to his room, very bored and out of it and resentful and wondering Where Did I Go Wrong? I think I went wrong in the two exhausting days being filmed for French TV, which set me up for the flu by sapping all my strength. 

How are you, as they say. What outré projects (no offense meant) are you into now? 

I am so fucked up by the flu that I forget if I told you that UA is buying DO ANDROIDS DREAM OF ELECTRIC SHEEP? We are super broke, but that contract should arrive soon and pay its $2,000 option money fast (we tell ourselves little fairy tales like this to keep our morale up). Anyhow the baby and cat are fine, since they are too dumb to know we are in debt and can’t pay our rent and are sick and all sorts of other bad things. The TV, even, broke, but I got them to come fix it cheap here in the house, since I can’t go anywhere it being the only thing I can do...
